B8.title: Keep asking until a stop value
questionExamples: repeat until the user enters 0
until "stop" is entered
B8.python:
hours = int(input("Hours: "))
while hours != 0:
    ...
    hours = int(input("Hours: "))
B8.erl:
hours = input("Hours")
while hours != 0
    ...
    hours = input("Hours")
endwhile
B8.commonMistake: Asking only before the loop, so it never stops
